old: The Cloud sign-up page asks for an email address (one rendering labels it Company email) and then continues; the trial needs no credit card. Fields after the email step are unverified.
new: The Cloud sign-up page asks first for an email address (labelled Company email in one rendering and Email in another; the step can answer 'Email domain is not allowed') and then verifies it: a link is sent to that address, or a code is entered on the page. A details form follows with Full name, Password (8+ characters, at least one number and one uppercase letter) and Instance name (it becomes the instance URL), an optional newsletter checkbox and a Cloudflare Turnstile bot check. The form submits no phone number, company name or card detail. A multiple-choice onboarding survey that includes the company size opens once the account exists. The trial needs no credit card. Whether a screen inside the created account asks for more is unverified: behind a sign-up.
